name: base-blockers
summary: Base blockers (the community's "Mickey Mouse fountain"): spawn protection checks the hero itself again, as in Aug 2022, not the first player's hero

assets.why: Spawn protection in your base (immune, no abilities until you leave) went to every hero whenever the first player in the match stood in a base, wherever that hero was: Feb 2023's HasRespawnedInsideBase asks GetPlayerPawn(0) instead of the hero. Aug 2022 asked the hero itself (IsInsideSpawnBlockers). Now the hero itself again, so the protection is only on heroes inside a base, and leaving the base takes it off.
